==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My girlfriend's sleep talk made me lucid (I could hear her voice coming from the waking world, but it wasn't enough of a disturbance to fully wake me up). I returned to battle the Death Witch (Woman, pale skin, straight black hair, red eyes, long tattered black robes, a belt made of skulls, and a wooden staff that radiates with purple energy). (I willingly used my lucidity to continue a continuity of dreams that started back at 06/11/2025.) I summoned golems to overwhelm and disarm the Death Witch. (The golems surrounded her and took her wooden power staff. My knowledge of golem folklore made me confident that she wouldn't be able to easily manipulate my golems, despite her knowing geomancy. Golems are notoriously difficult to control. My edge was my lucidity, which made the golems easier to manipulate.) Weakened, she is now in a stone cell, but the Elven Village is plagued by her now leaderless zombies. (Her zombies are definitely something new. A part of the Death Witch's plan that I still haven't figured out.)
